title: AlignBench: Benchmarking Chinese Alignment of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by comparing general LLM-as-Judge scores against multi-dimensional rule-calibrated judge scores on verbose but incorrect model responses (e.g., in mathematical reasoning) to test if the evaluator unfairly rewards length over accuracy.

Addressed and mitigated by adopting a point-wise grading approach with Chain-of-Thought instead of pairwise comparisons, preventing the evaluator model from favoring responses based on their presentation order.
